title: Waiver registry — /waivers/{node_id}.json and /waivers/all.json
description: The published waiver registry: one document per repository, plus a global `/waivers/all.json` whose entries each carry `repoNodeId`. The second of the three cov-v1 inputs (FS-10 §4.2). Waivers are gratis and are granted only by a claimed admin from the platform dashboard (D14) — they can never enter the registry by pull request, which is why the P-M2 registry source has no waivers field at all (FS02-060). At P-M2 every document is the honest empty state `waivers: []`, and the project page says so in words rather than showing a zero (VS-18). `coolingEndsAt` (= grantedAt + 72 h, D14 as amended) is consumed by VESTING only (FS05-063): a waiver inside its cooling window is coverage-eligible exactly like any other, because cooling governs whether vesting attaches permanently, never today's coverage answer. Revocation is PROSPECTIVE: `revokedAt` in the past removes coverage from that instant onward while the certificate verify record still attests the historical window (CERT-042).

x-psn.phase: P-M2 (honest empty state) · populated at P-M3

nodeId.description: Present on a per-repository document; absent on the global `/waivers/all.json`, whose entries carry `repoNodeId` instead.

scope.description: Which document this is. `repo` ⇒ `nodeId` is set; `all` ⇒ every entry sets `repoNodeId`.

waivers.description: Waiver grants. An empty array is a valid and expected state — it means no waiver exists, not that data is missing.

repoNodeId.description: Required in `/waivers/all.json`; redundant (and normally omitted) in a per-repository document.

beneficiary.description: Who the waiver covers. Every grant mints an UNVERIFIED `co_` stub plus a registry entry at grant time, so a beneficiary with no account and no verified domain still resolves by ULID (FS-10 §4.3 step 2 — the reachability rule). Name-only lookups are answered by this public artifact, never by cov-v1.

domain.description: Matched by cov-v1 only against a company's VERIFIED domains.

grantedAt.description: Coverage starts at this instant, cooling window notwithstanding.

coolingEndsAt.description: grantedAt + 72 h (D14 as amended). Vesting-only input (FS05-063); cov-v1 ignores it.

revokedAt.description: Prospective revocation instant. Absent or null ⇒ live. Revocation INSIDE the cooling window voids the waiver ab initio and no vesting ever attaches.

grantedBy.description: Only a claimed repository admin can grant a waiver (D14). Recorded so the artifact carries its own provenance; no other value is issuable.

note.description: Optional public note from the granting admin. Repository-side content — escaped on render.
